tasks.title: Add slash command installation to ralph init
tasks.description:
In `src/commands/init.ts`, add a function `installSlashCommands(projectRoot: string)` that copies all `.md` files from the ralph repo's `commands/` directory into the target project's `.claude/commands/` directory.

Follow the `installNarrationHooks()` pattern:
1. Use `resolveRalphRoot()` from `src/utils.ts` to find the ralph repo root
2. Read all `.md` files from `<ralphRoot>/commands/`
3. Create `.claude/commands/` in the target project (mkdirSync recursive)
4. Copy each file, overwriting if it exists (these are ralph-managed, not user-edited)
5. Log what was created/updated

This should be unconditional (no prompt) — called from `runInit()` after core file creation.

TDD approach:
- Write tests first in `test/commands/init.test.ts`
- Test cases: directory created, files copied, idempotent (re-run overwrites), handles missing commands dir gracefully
- Use temp directories for test isolation
- Then implement the function

IMPORTANT: Import `resolveRalphRoot` from `../utils` (or `../utils.js` depending on module resolution).
tasks.notes: Added installSlashCommands(projectRoot, ralphRoot?) that copies .md files from ralph's commands/ dir to target's .claude/commands/. Wired unconditionally into runInit() after initCoreFiles(). Updated existing runInit test that checked .claude didn't exist (now .claude/commands/ always exists). 87 init tests pass, 738 total tests pass.

tasks.title: Simplify runPlan() and delete obsolete code
tasks.description:
This is the main refactor task. Replace the multi-session orchestration in `runPlan()` with a single interactive claude spawn, and delete all obsolete functions.

New `runPlan()` should:
1. Call `displayPreflight()` (keep as-is)
2. Build system prompt via simplified `buildPlanningPrompt()`
3. Spawn ONE interactive `claude --append-system-prompt <prompt> --allowedTools Read,Glob,Grep,Write,Edit` session
4. When the user exits claude, ralph is done — return immediately

Delete the following functions and their tests:
- `buildTaskGenPrompt()` — moved to `commands/generate-tasks.md`
- `buildReviewPrompt()` — moved to `commands/review-tasks.md`
- `buildRegeneratorPrompt()` — no longer needed
- `spawnReviewer()` — replaced by slash command
- `spawnRegenerator()` — replaced by slash command
- `runAutoReview()` — replaced by slash command
- `parseReviewFeedback()` — reviewer reports conversationally now
- `reviewNotesLoop()` — replaced by natural conversation
- `reviewTasksLoop()` — replaced by natural conversation
- `launchPlanningSession()` — collapsed into runPlan()
- `launchTaskGeneration()` — collapsed into runPlan()

Delete all associated types/interfaces:
- `LaunchPlanningSessionOpts`, `LaunchTaskGenerationOpts`
- `SpawnReviewerOpts`, `SpawnReviewerDeps`
- `SpawnRegeneratorOpts`, `SpawnRegeneratorDeps`
- `RunAutoReviewOpts`, `ReviewTasksLoopOpts`, `ReviewNotesLoopOpts`
- `ReviewDimension`, `ReviewResult`
- Simplify `RunPlanOpts` to only what's needed (projectName, projectRoot, dataDir, agents)

Delete internal helpers that are no longer used:
- `tryReadFile()`, `fileSection()` — verify no remaining callers first
- `computeGitStatus()` — only used by deleted task gen prompt
- `defaultEditFn()` — only used by deleted menu loops

Remove the `tasksSchemaRaw` import (schema is now in the slash command file).

Remove the menu.ts import (but don't delete menu.ts yet — task 6 handles that).

TDD approach:
- Delete obsolete tests first
- Write new tests for simplified `runPlan()` (spawns claude with correct args, system prompt contains project context)
- Then implement

Verify `bun test test/commands/plan.test.ts` passes after all changes.

tasks.title: Delete menu.ts
tasks.description:
Remove `src/menu.ts` and `test/menu.test.ts`. Verify no remaining imports of menu.ts anywhere in the codebase (grep for 'menu' in src/ and test/ directories). Remove any lingering import statements.

This should be straightforward — the only consumer was plan.ts menu loops, which were removed in task 5.

tasks.title: Verify build and full test suite
tasks.description:
Final verification task. Run the full test suite and build to ensure everything works after all refactoring.

1. Run `bun test` — all tests must pass
2. Run `bun run build` — must compile without errors
3. Run `./dist/ralph plan --help` — smoke test that the command still registers
4. Verify `commands/generate-tasks.md` and `commands/review-tasks.md` exist and are well-formed
5. If any issues found, fix them

The `commands/` directory is static markdown — it doesn't need to be compiled, just needs to be findable at runtime via `resolveRalphRoot()`.
